exposure: blood loss during cesarean section (more than 500mL)
poor hygienic care after cesarean section
emergency cesarean section under improper aseptic conditions
cohort: 100 women who underwent cesarean delivery and presented in surgical emergency at Mayo Hospital Lahore within 8 months (September 2020 to April 2021).
finding: Higher BMI, increased blood loss during cesarean section, poor hygiene, low socioeconomic status, lack of education, and emergency cesarean section under improper aseptic conditions were associated with surgical site infections.
